title: A7S III 5.01: rear screen and viewfinder show the open-gate live view at 3:2: the letterbox of a 16:9 picture is given the height width x 2/3, and the frame widgets expect the live view there
artifact: cpapp-b.bin 5.01 (ILCE-7SM3), its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the words are in the file, the change is made in RAM only
replaces: lcdfill_s3_v1, which changes a word this camera does not read (camera test 2026-11-22: the screen stayed at 16:9)

summary.panel: rear LCD and viewfinder, both 4:3 panels (panel code 0); inferred from the camera test and the firmware
summary.picture: 16:9 live view (picture code 2), which in the open-gate state holds the whole 3:2 sensor area squeezed
goes_with: the A7S III open-gate state (ogsq_s3_v5, outsz2560_s3_v1, ogfile2560_hs_s_s3_v1)

while_applied: every 16:9 picture on the rear screen and in the viewfinder is shown at 3:2 (other movie formats look squeezed there); HDMI is unchanged
checked_against: cpapp-b.bin 5.01: every site and guard byte
the function's own 3:2 case (lr 2, r0 3) and the tables' 3:2 height 428
not_checked: on a camera: this design has not run
the panel-type bytes 0x14b9600 and 0x14b9730 (not read yet; the dump of helper s3read_v8 reads them)
which table row the rear panel's widgets use (rows 0 and 2 are both set)

sites.note: picture-ratio function, 16:9 picture: `moveq.w lr, #9` to `#2` (the numerator of height = width x n / d)
picture-ratio function, 16:9 picture: `it eq; moveq r0, #16` to `#3` (the denominator). With 2 and 3 the function adds 3 to the width first, as for its own 3:2 pictures: 640 wide gives 428 high
